stem:
Meena wants to measure the length of her pencil. The zero end of her scale is broken, so she places one end of the pencil at the 2 cm mark. The other end of the pencil is at the 15 cm mark.
What is the length of the pencil?

teacher.key_rationale: Length is the difference between the two readings: 15 cm − 2 cm = 13 cm. Option B is the trap for reading the far endpoint directly; A is the trap for adding the readings; D is a random near-miss.
